versions.content: If the upper layer transport protocol module reports BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK in a call to PduR_SecOCTpCopyTxData then SecOC shall immediately abort the transmission via calling PduR_SecOCTpTxConfirmation with E_NOT_OK result, shall stop all internal actions related to the Authentic I - PDU, and shall free all related buffers.
